document_data.content:
Dear Dr. Kim,

I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing to refer my patient, Brian Turner, following a workplace fitness evaluation. It is crucial to note that he has expressed a preference against external referrals and sharing the evaluation findings outside of our clinic team. Therefore, I will not be providing specific details regarding his evaluation in this letter, as per his request.

I appreciate your understanding and consideration in this matter. Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Dr. Ana Rivera
